annotations.text:
Previous flier, rebuilt 1:1 from flier.html as it stood until 2026-10-07.
The Screen / Print switch above it swaps between that version's two palettes.

Three redesign directions, same content and brand, body type at 12pt or larger.
A · Poster: one big headline, the five facts, a big QR. Drops coursework and alumni.
B · Editorial: photo-led, prose plus an at-a-glance card. Ink-heavy, no alumni line.
C · Pathway: the applicant's path as numbered steps, facts in a rail. Reads as a sequence.
Picked 2026-10-07: A · Poster, now flier.html with the MPA card's headline and palm photo.
